name: Soft Editorial
description: Warm magazine-spread editorial system. Cormorant Garamond carries every headline and ornamental moment with mixed roman and italic; Work Sans recedes into supporting body. Cream paper canvas with five pastel accent card fills (dusty pink, chartreuse lemon, soft peach blush, sage green, lilac). Generous rounded cards (24-36px radius) float on translucent white over the cream field. No drop shadows — depth comes from translucency and rounded form. Italic serif for all chrome: page numerals, footers, kickers, markers. Roman-numeral step ordinals. Drop caps open long-form paragraphs.
descriptionZh: 温暖杂志跨页编辑系统。Cormorant Garamond 处理所有标题和装饰元素，正体与斜体混用；Work Sans 退居正文辅助。奶油色纸张画布搭配五种粉彩强调色卡片填充（灰粉、柠檬黄、蜜桃、鼠尾草绿、淡紫）。圆角卡片（24-36px 半径）以半透明白色浮于奶油底色之上。无投影——层次来自半透明和圆角形态。斜体衬线用于所有铬元素。
avoidFor: 需要视觉热度或冲击力的演示
